identity.title: Qualify Good Bad Held-out no-leakage verification

origin.summary: The owner selected the ranked next priority. M-14 remained New although the current Validation Set verifier and Runner already expose exact Good, Bad, and Held-out exclusion evidence.

state.current_summary: M-14 is closed by one counterfactual check in the existing Validation Set verifier: changing only Held-out value and identity leaves the complete development fingerprint unchanged while Good and Bad development evidence remains fixed.

objective.summary: Close M-14 with current reusable evidence that Held-out samples remain visible and replayable but cannot enter threshold development, ranking, counts, warnings, or candidate decisions.
constraints: Reuse ToolRecipeValidationSetVerification, ToolRecipeThresholdCandidateAnalyzer, the existing Shell command, and the existing Runner labeled-validation command.
Add only one adversarial check to the existing verifier; do not add a duplicate verifier, assertion framework, product implementation, or CI command.
Preserve role persistence, source and recipe immutability, explicit Run and replay boundaries, and Workbench/Runner shared contracts.
Do not change UI, schema, recipe behavior, Preview/Publish/Run semantics, product version, R0, or release state.

criteria.text: The current suite proves durable Good, Bad, and Held-out roles, exact role counts, visible Held-out statistics with IncludedInDevelopment=false, and role save/reopen without source, recipe, or automatic execution mutation.

The threshold suite proves four development samples and one separately identified Held-out sample, exactly 48 deterministic candidates, exact development decisions and confusion counts, zero Held-out candidate decisions or warning identities, and an unchanged complete candidate/warning fingerprint when only Held-out value and identity change.
Current direct Runner JSON preserves Good 2, Bad 2, Held-out 1, development 4, excluded Held-out 1, candidate count 48, and zero Held-out decisions through the shared analyzer contract.
The existing hosted CI command remains the sole Validation Set gate and fails unless the updated existing verifier passes all exactly 87 cases.

Current-tree Release build, final Validation Set and Runner checks, standard test facade, NuGet health, structure guard, fixed Vision SDK package guard, issue validation, documentation targets, tracked JSON, and diff hygiene pass.

context.summary: Current WPF-neutral Validation Set contract verifier with an exact 86-case return gate.
Separates Good and Bad development observations from auditable Held-out identities.
Current Workbench contract step already invokes --verify-validation-set and checks its exit code.

evidence.observation: The current existing Validation Set verifier passed exactly 87/87 with 87 PASS lines and zero FAIL lines. It retains durable Good, Bad, and Held-out roles, exact role counts, IncludedInDevelopment=false, save/reopen and non-mutation checks, four development samples, one separately identified Held-out sample, exactly 48 deterministic candidates, exact development decisions/confusion, and zero Held-out candidate decisions or warning identities. The added counterfactual changed the Held-out raw-height fixture from 3 to 1,000,000 and changed its identity while the serialized complete development candidate, limit, order, ranking, warning, confusion, and exact sample-decision fingerprint remained unchanged.

Current direct Runner JSON through the shared analyzer records five samples as Good 2, Bad 2, Held-out 1; development 4; excluded Held-out 1; 48 candidates; 192 development decisions; and zero Held-out decisions.

Current-tree verification passed: focused and 15-project Release builds produced zero warnings/errors; Validation Set passed 87/87; direct Runner no-leakage summary passed; standard test facade passed 2/2; NuGet health covered 15 projects with vulnerable/deprecated 0/0; structure passed 68/68; and the fixed Vision SDK source/package identity passed. Source inspection confirms the hosted workflow still invokes --verify-validation-set exactly once and the existing verifier now returns success only for passed == total == 87. All 92 repository and Proofline JSON files parsed, all six PL-0043 documentation targets existed, PL-0043 validated as v2, and git diff --check returned no whitespace errors. Hosted CI and UI runtime were not run for this non-UI verifier-only slice.

After the terminal issue and documentation update, PL-0043 validated as resolved v2 with evidence on all criteria; all 92 repository and Proofline JSON files parsed; all six required PL-0043 durable documents existed; the master inventory recorded 148 C / 16 P / 46 N / 9 E / 16 O and M-14 Complete; and git diff --check exited successfully with only existing line-ending conversion warnings.

events.summary: Resolved after all five acceptance criteria received current evidence.
